speaker: Edward Dube
role: Of the Presidency of the Seventy
title: Come unto Christ
summary: Elder Dube teaches that we do not have to perfect ourselves before coming to Christ; we come to Christ to be perfected. He tells how President Oaks had a “Trespassers will be prosecuted” sign taken off a mission gate in 1987, and how a ministering visit led a man trying to quit smoking and his wife to be sealed, after she was told in prayer that he only needed to do his best. He invites everyone, including those whose faith has grown uncertain, to come unto Christ and to help one other person come too.
